Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, driven by capacity expansion in value-added coated steel products including the new Alu-Zinc line. Consolidated revenues crossed the Rs 1,000 crore milestone, supported by improved operating leverage, higher capacity utilisation, and a geographically diversified domestic sales footprint. The company maintained a debt-light balance sheet with no long-term debt and upgraded its credit rating to ICRA A. Management outlined targets for continued revenue growth in subsequent years backed by ongoing capital expenditure. Manaksia Steels Limited reported its financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, highlighting revenue of H584.18 Crore and a 15% increase in sales tonnage.

guidance.claim: The company expects the new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA to result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity.
guidance.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year.

guidance.claim: The second expansion programme for the colour coating manufacturing line is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.
guidance.quote: This investment is expected to generate annual revenue of H500 Crore at peak manufacturing capacity.

demand_outlook.claim: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized, and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings, and industrial infrastructure.
demand_outlook.quote: Rising household incomes are accelerating the adoption of Galvalume, galvanized and colour-coated steel across housing, commercial buildings and industrial infrastructure

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the global economic environment remains fragile and leads to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
